repos_data.description: Building a Better Democracy for the Internet Age
Philippine civic data as MCP tools: the full PSA OpenSTAT statistical catalog, hazards, weather, procurement, elections, and one-call area profiles. 41 tools, no API keys.
MCP server for the Federal Register of Legislation: search Australian Commonwealth law, read it as it stood on any date, and check citations against the official register

MCP TypeScript qui croise et réconcilie 13 référentiels publics français (santé, démographie, entreprises, géo, immobilier) — détecte les SIRET fermés invisibles côté DREES, évalue le potentiel immobilier d'un site (DVF €/m², permis, PLU). 36 tools. Pour Claude, Cursor & toute app TS.
Free, nonpartisan, bilingual tool to find your members of Congress, understand active bills in plain language, and call. Privacy-first: no accounts, no tracking.
